title: Split character correlation
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $H$ be a linear subspace of $( br/	ext{?})^n$ over the two-element field, and let a binary subspace split of $H$ have complementary dimension $d$. For a function $f$ from the $n$-dimensional binary cube to the signs $\\{\pm1\}$, its split character correlation is the average over independent uniform $a,b$ in the $d$-dimensional binary cube and uniform $h\in H$ of the product of the sign values of $f$ at the three points corresponding to $(h,a)$, $(0,b)$, and $(0,a+b)$ under the split coordinates.
hypotheses_covered: A subspace $H$ of the $n$-dimensional cube over $\mathbb{F}_2$
A function from the $n$-dimensional binary cube to the signs
